# Split the fee calculation into its two components

`src/normalise.py::fee_for()` computes the flat fee and the regional handling charge in a single
expression, which makes it hard to read and hard to change one without disturbing the other.

Extract them into two private helpers — `_flat_component()` and `_handling_component()` — and have
`fee_for()` return their sum.

This is a pure internal refactor:

- `fee_for()` must return an identical value for every input it accepts today.
- `artifacts/report.golden.txt` must be byte-for-byte unchanged by this item.
- No public name changes.
